reason: The indexed monoclinic cell, likely Z=2, density, and broad borate-framework family are plausible, but exact recovery is not established. The supplied comparable whole-pattern report is unavailable, and the reported match of observed peaks to calculated positions tests the lattice rather than coordinates or ordering. The trajectory's last quantified intensity fit preceded the final collision-fix, while the submitted model still has serious physical defects (minimum O-O 1.741 A, Bi-O contacts of 1.725 and 1.803 A, and one nominal B-O contact at 1.600 A). P-1 was adopted from an inversion-paired, prototype-derived construction without quantitative comparison to monoclinic symmetry alternatives, and Al/Ga ordering alternatives were ranked mainly through inherited-topology geometry rather than independent whole-pattern fits. A materially different symmetry/order realization with a chemically sound framework could plausibly improve the candidate set, so another attempt is warranted.
